The instance-profile and policy-attachment entries remain necessary; the role entry is duplicated.

`null_resource.update_trust_policy` depends_on `kubernetes_namespace.spark`, but the provisioner command already interpolates `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}` (the `--namespace` argument), so the ordering is already implicit via that attribute reference. The explicit `depends_on` entry duplicates it.
